question: In March 2022, Tripura government announced __ __ reservation for women in government jobs.
solution:
The correct answer is __**33 percent.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For all** state government jobs and admission** to higher education institutions, the Tripura government has decided to grant a **33% reservation** to all **women.**
 
• All female applicants to **Institutes of National Importance **will receive **3%** off of whatever **loans **they take out.
 
• Women will be given a** 50% reservation** to **run businesses** in government marketplaces or retail centers.
 
• **50% of the venture capital fund** is set aside to** support female-led enterprises.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to Amit Shah, **farmer earnings** have more than doubled, and the **per capita income** has increased to Rs** 1.3 lakh.**
 
• **Rail** has been used to **connect Agartala **with the rest of the nation.
 
• The **length** of the nation's highways is **542 km.**
 
• The Union Home Minister claims that there has been a** 30% drop in heinous crimes **in Tripura and an improvement in the c**onviction rate from 5% to 53%.**
